explanation: Rechecking gives P(x)=1/[x(x+1)] and Q(x)=ln(x)/(x-3). At 0, x²Q(x) is not analytic, giving irregular singular; at 2 both coefficients are analytic, giving ordinary; at 3 the weighted coefficients are analytic, giving regular singular. The earlier uncertainty remains: real ln(x) is undefined near -1, so no offered classification there is justified for the real equation. A local complex logarithm branch would give regular singular, but that interpretation is unspecified.
